title: Shifted binary coefficients
statement: Given a coefficient vector $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$ and a nonnegative integer $d$, the shifted coefficient at position $d$ is $0$ if $d=0$, and otherwise is the coefficient of $a$ at position $d-1$, with value $0$ when $d-1\ge\ell$.
